author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 6; ensure at least four current turns classified as general across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer asks about a smartwatch they bought and then shifts to a general question.

messages.content: Hi, I got the FitPulse S2 watch last week. The heart-rate reading seems off when I run.
Sorry to hear that. Have you tried tightening the strap one notch during workouts? A loose fit can skew the sensor.
I'll try that. Actually, do you folks have a physical store downtown?

variants.text: Great, I'll test it on my next jog. And thanks for the tip!
variants.label: general

variants.text: I tightened it but it still shows 140 when I'm barely moving. Should I send it back?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Wait, before I forget — can you also tell me if the S2 is waterproof for swimming?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer asks about a delayed delivery then makes a small-talk remark.

messages.content: My order #48213 was supposed to arrive Tuesday but tracking hasn't moved since Monday.
Let me check. I see it's held at the regional hub due to weather. It should move out tomorrow.
Okay, that's a relief. By the way, is it supposed to rain here this weekend?

variants.text: Haha, I know you're not a weather service. Thanks for checking on my package though!
variants.label: general

variants.text: If it's stuck another day, can I just cancel and get a refund?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, could you reroute it to my office address instead?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer had a return processed and now asks about a discount code.

messages.content: I returned the blender last week. The refund showed up on my card yesterday, so that's sorted.
Glad it went through smoothly! Is there anything else I can help with?
Yes — do you have any promo codes active right now?

variants.text: Never mind the code. I just wanted to confirm the refund, so I'm all set. Have a good day!
variants.label: general

variants.text: I'm eyeing the stand mixer. Is it compatible with the attachments from my old model?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, the refund was $12 short of what I paid. Can you look into that?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer locked out of account and then asks a casual question.

messages.content: I can't log in — it says my password is wrong, but I'm sure it's correct.
No problem. I've sent a reset link to your email on file. Check the inbox and spam folder.
Got it, thanks. Hey, do you know if your company is hiring right now?

variants.text: The reset link worked, I'm back in. And no worries about the hiring question — just curious!
variants.label: general

variants.text: The link expired before I clicked it. Can you send another one?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: I'm in now, but I noticed someone changed my saved address. Did someone access my account?
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer asks about a damaged item and then requests a human agent.

messages.content: The ceramic vase I ordered arrived cracked. I'd like a replacement.
I'm sorry about that. I can start a replacement right away — just confirm your order number.
It's #77102. But honestly, I'd rather talk to a real person about this.

variants.text: Actually, a replacement is fine. Please go ahead and process it.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Can you transfer me to a supervisor? I've had three damaged deliveries from you this year.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Never mind the vase — I'll just glue it. Thanks anyway!
variants.label: general

families.scenario: Customer asks about a subscription renewal and then makes a general comment.

messages.content: My coffee subscription renews on the 15th. I want to skip next month's box.
Sure — I've marked your account to skip the March delivery. You won't be charged.
Perfect. You know, I've been really happy with the Ethiopian roast lately.

variants.text: Anyway, that's all I needed. Thanks for the quick help!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, change that — I want to cancel the subscription entirely instead.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Also, can you tell me if the March box will include the new decaf option?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer asks about a warranty claim and then asks about store hours.

messages.content: My headphones stopped charging after three months. Is that covered under warranty?
Yes, they carry a one-year warranty. I can file a claim — do you have the receipt handy?
I do. Also, what time do you open on Saturdays?

variants.text: We open at 9 AM on Saturdays. Would you like to bring the headphones in instead of filing online?
variants.label: general

variants.text: Here's my receipt number. Please go ahead and file the claim.
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, I'd rather just get a refund since I've had nothing but trouble with these.
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer asks about a gift order and then asks a general question about the company.

messages.content: I ordered a gift basket for my mom's birthday on the 20th. Can you confirm it'll arrive in time?
It's scheduled for delivery on the 19th, so you're all set. Anything else?
Great. How long has your company been around, by the way?

variants.text: We've been in business since 2009. Is there anything else I can help you with?
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, can you add a handwritten card to the basket? It hasn't shipped yet, right?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: If it arrives late, will you refund the shipping fee automatically?
variants.label: billing_refund
